Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Berserker
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Berserker, permanently give him +2F and the ability, "Reaction: After another player's action targets this Personality: Delay his destruction from the action's effects until before this turn ends." Otherwise, permanently give him Berserker.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Duelist
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Duelist, permanently give him the ability, "Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Personality: This Personality duels him. Move the duel's loser home." Otherwise, permanently give him Duelist.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Paragon
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Paragon, permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Target an enemy Personality with either equal or lower Force, or equal or lower Personal Honor: Bow him." Otherwise, permanently give him Paragon.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Scout
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Scout, permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Bow this Personality unless you have Reconnaissance: Ranged 4 Attack." Otherwise, permanently give him Scout.

Cards.Name: Spirit of the Yojimbo
Cards.Text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Yojimbo, permanently give him the ability, "Reaction: After another player's action targets one of your Personalities at this Personality's location: The action targets this Personality instead, if legal." Otherwise, permanently give him Yojimbo.
